mapper.select: SELECT NULL AS id, artifact.id AS artifact_id, artifact_version.id AS artifact_version_id, NULL AS export_key, NULL AS request_fingerprint, artifact_version.content_format AS format, NULL AS status, NULL AS storage_ref, NULL AS size_bytes, NULL AS content_hash, NULL AS error_code, NULL AS error_summary, NULL AS created_at, NULL AS updated_at, NULL AS finished_at, artifact.workspace_id, artifact.task_id, artifact.source_run_id, data_analysis_task.dataset_id, data_analysis_task.sheet_id, artifact.artifact_type, artifact.title AS artifact_title, artifact_version.version_number, artifact_version.content_ref AS source_content_ref, artifact_version.content_format AS source_content_format FROM artifact JOIN workspace ON workspace.id = artifact.workspace_id AND workspace.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN artifact_version ON artifact_version.id = #{artifactVersionId} AND artifact_version.artifact_id = artifact.id LEFT JOIN data_analysis_task ON data_analysis_task.task_id = artifact.task_id WHERE artifact.id = #{artifactId} AND artifact.status = 'READY' FOR UPDATE
